notes: This manifest replaces the legacy six pretraining-heavy topic pairs with 50 post-release or post-2025 topic pairs for unlearning experiments.
The cutoff for avoiding Llama 3.1 pretraining exposure is Meta Llama 3.1 release date: 2024-07-23.
New product topics are constrained to mid-2025 through mid-2026 whenever possible, following the project discussion.
Political and cultural events are constrained to 2025 or later.
Some product/model topics are represented by a broader canonical Wikipedia page plus a specific section; Step 3 extraction should focus on the named release section.
